_doc: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-23. Frozen BEFORE any re-measurement under this protocol. Do not edit thresholds after seeing OOS. Bump protocol_id to change.

reason_supersede: 12bps flat cost on gold M15 often yields cost_R>1 (45%+ of TP paths net-negative)
E2 random control membership inflated (duplicate arm tags)

authority.note: Even a future M4 PROMOTE under this protocol is research-only until separate E3 + human gate + ΔG001 on live path.

model.note: v1 measures the EXISTING weights under new cost/entry/control. Retrain is a NEW protocol_id.

primary.definition: First bar where CRT current_state becomes RETEST (prev_state != RETEST), with resolvable direction.

forbidden_without_new_protocol_id: TRADE_OPENED-only as sole set without declaring underpowered

diagnostics_only.TRADE_OPENED: report n only; never primary gate if n < qualification.min_samples
diagnostics_only.SWEEP: shadow comparison table only; not primary arm universe

atr_source_priority: feature_pipeline.atr * close if atr appears relative (0<atr<1 and close>1)
exit_geometry.note: Same 1R/1R as v0 so cost model is the isolated change vs v0; planner-true SL/TP is protocol_id bump.

primary.definition: cost_R = usd_round_trip / risk_distance; risk_distance = sl_atr_mult * atr_abs
primary.rationale_pre_registered: Flat 12bps on XAU M15 produced cost_R>1 on ~45% of TP paths (falsification). Fixed USD spread is a standard metals research alternative. 0.40 USD RT is a declared prior (approx 0.20/side), NOT fit to maximize E[R].

sensitivity_pre_registered.role: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY — primary gate uses 0.40 only; grid cannot promote

forbidden: Choosing usd_round_trip after seeing OOS E[R]
Per-bar adaptive spread fit on the same corpus used for OOS
Adding arms after seeing results without protocol_id bump

control_arm.name: random_match_n
definition: Let T = {i in train : score_i >= p90_train}
Let O = {i in oos : score_i >= p90_train}
Draw |T| indices uniformly without replacement from train candidates; seed S_train
Draw |O| indices uniformly without replacement from oos candidates; seed S_oos
Union is random_match_n; each unit tagged ONLY with arm id 'random_match_n' (single tag, no _train/_oos duplicates in membership list used by M4)
forbidden: Union of random_match_n + random_match_n_train + random_match_n_oos as separate inclusive filters
control_arm.acceptance_test: len(random_match_n) == len(nb_top_decile) AND len(random_train)==len(top_train) AND len(random_oos)==len(top_oos)

promote_unsafe_if: pooled IS+OOS expectancy used without reporting OOS-only E

kill_criteria.E1_relative: If OOS top E[R] <= OOS all AND <= OOS random → NO_RELATIVE_SKILL
kill_criteria.E1_absolute: If OOS top E[R] < 0 → NO_ABSOLUTE_EDGE (still run M4 for formal record)
kill_criteria.E2_m4: If primary nb_top_decile verdict != PROMOTE → no E3
kill_criteria.stop: Do not invent entries/costs after kill; bump protocol_id for any change

execution_order: P0 freeze this file in git / record sha256
P1 stream RETEST_EDGE candidates + journal v1.1
P2 score with frozen model (no retrain)
P3 label net R with XAU_COST_V1 primary + sensitivity grid diagnostic
P7 write manifests; economic_authority_granted=false unless human E3 later
